$comment: Source of truth for what the WRLD design system publishes to 21st.dev. Drive it with scripts/publish_21st.mjs (npm run registry:publish). The script writes the stable component refs back here after a publish; never replace a recorded ref with a slug guess. No credentials belong in this file.

components.name: WRLD Button
components.description: WRLD button with primary, secondary, ghost and warm (commerce) variants. Monochrome at rest, accent-tinted shadow lift on hover only. Use for every call to action on a WRLD property.

components.name: WRLD Eyebrow
components.description: Uppercase, letter-spaced eyebrow label that sits above a heading. Use to name a section before its display heading, in marketing pages and dashboards alike.

components.name: WRLD Lockup
components.description: Canonical WRLD lockup: the authentic starburst mark, the Montserrat wordmark and an optional sub-brand label such as TECH, AI or HOST. Use in navigation, footers and sub-brand cards.

components.name: WRLD Help Button
components.description: Circular warm-accent help launcher, the canonical visual of the WRLD Help widget corner button. Use wherever a menu, card or prototype represents Help.

components.name: WRLD Stat Card
components.description: Single KPI tile with an eyebrow label, a display value and a signed delta. Use in WRLD.AI dashboards, reports and account overviews.

components.name: WRLD Top Bar
components.description: Dashboard top bar with an eyebrow subtitle, the page title and a primary action pair. Use at the top of a WRLD.AI content pane.

components.name: WRLD Run History
components.description: Chronological list of agent run outcomes with success, running and failed states as status pills. Use on agent detail and monitoring views.

components.name: WRLD Agent List
components.description: Selectable list of AI agents with a status dot, a summary line and run counts. Use as the primary list of a WRLD.AI agents view.

components.name: WRLD Hero
components.description: wrld.tech marketing hero: eyebrow, display headline, lede and a call-to-action row. Use as the single hero element of a WRLD landing page.

components.name: WRLD CTA
components.description: Closing call-to-action band on an inverted monochrome surface with a contact line. Use once, at the end of a WRLD marketing page.

components.name: WRLD Values Strip
components.description: Numbered values strip with a title and a supporting line per value, five columns on desktop. Use to present principles, process steps or differentiators.

components.name: WRLD Services Grid
components.description: Grid of sub-brand service cards, each with a WRLD lockup, a summary and an accent-tinted hover. Use to present a portfolio of properties or services.

components.name: WRLD Footer
components.description: Site footer with the WRLD lockup, link columns and a legal line. Use as the closing element of every WRLD marketing page.

components.name: WRLD Sidebar
components.description: Dashboard left navigation with the WRLD.AI lockup, workspace links with Lucide icons and a plan footer. Use as the primary navigation of a WRLD.AI product surface.

components.name: WRLD Agent Detail
components.description: Detail pane for one AI agent: header with actions, description, four KPI tiles and the recent run history. Use as the main pane of a WRLD.AI agents view.

components.name: WRLD Header
components.description: Sticky wrld.tech site header with a morphing lockup, animated submenus and a traveling underline; collapses to a drawer below 900px. Use as the site chrome of a WRLD marketing property.
